Langfuse real export fixtures
=============================

Captured 2026-09-30 from a local, self-hosted Langfuse started once with Docker
Compose for this purpose, then torn down. All data is synthetic (example.com,
documentation IP ranges).

Versions
--------
Langfuse release v4.48.0 (health endpoint reported {"status":"OK","version":"4.48.0"}).
Compose file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/langfuse/langfuse/v4.48.0/docker-compose.yml
  tag v4.48.0 = commit 0de9ccd64e0f9d35c1990fb6c851fa00530e7960 (also main on that date).
Images (tag -> digest):
  docker.langfuse.com/langfuse/langfuse:4         sha256:8c1b80ed7735be587974d603af0f6e0247b33d3b56c7d5ab9d2337aec313efa0
  docker.langfuse.com/langfuse/langfuse-worker:4  sha256:9349b003a453326b3d2e2033eb94fe5ca9ee12ee237779c10984b9d3dfe0f8ed
  clickhouse/clickhouse-server:25.12              sha256:8a790dd3468db22b1d4e7b18a176f378ff5ff6053b9c48dd4ea1fa71a24c5ba6
  cgr.dev/chainguard/minio:latest                 sha256:4692462f35d97d7e82c30371d82f057703c5d9489bcae726010594c812f2d285
  redis:7                                         sha256:c6eabf748fc7a61dbb5a705c78bcf3d6377b1127a97d0ce965c11c44ba46896f
  postgres:17                                     sha256:d74eeac9a635390a49bc21bd49fccd973de707e2a53a76ac49b552b8712ec46f
Sender: opentelemetry-sdk 1.45.0, opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http 1.45.0.

Compose changes: one line. The Redis host port mapping (loopback only) was changed
from host port 6379 to 16379 because 6379 was already in use on the host.
Environment (.env): TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false, LANGFUSE_S3_BATCH_EXPORT_ENABLED=true,
headless init LANGFUSE_INIT_ORG_ID=org-local, LANGFUSE_INIT_PROJECT_ID=proj-local,
LANGFUSE_INIT_PROJECT_PUBLIC_KEY=pk-lf-local, LANGFUSE_INIT_PROJECT_SECRET_KEY=sk-lf-local,
LANGFUSE_INIT_USER_EMAIL=admin@example.com (plus org/project/user names and a password).
The deployment ran in the default v4 write mode "events_only".

Sending
-------
send_spans.py (in this directory) was run once from a scratch directory with
  uv run --no-project --with opentelemetry-sdk --with opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http python send_spans.py
It posts OTLP/HTTP protobuf to http://localhost:3000/api/public/otel/v1/traces with
Basic auth pk-lf-local:sk-lf-local. 4 traces, 16 spans, every span exported.
Span start times are fixed at 2026-09-30T08:0x:00Z; createdAt/updatedAt in the
exports are the real ingestion times.

Requests (Basic auth pk-lf-local:sk-lf-local; bodies saved byte-for-byte)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
FIELDS = core,basic,time,io,metadata,model,usage,prompt,metrics,trace_context
KEYS   = every metadata key seen in the first pass, comma-separated:
  alert_class,attributes.detecttrace.alert_class,attributes.detecttrace.analyst_note,
  attributes.detecttrace.case_id,attributes.detecttrace.mfa_satisfied,
  attributes.detecttrace.prompt_version,attributes.detecttrace.result_count,
  attributes.detecttrace.risk_score,attributes.detecttrace.source_ips,
  attributes.detecttrace.verdict,attributes.error.type,attributes.gen_ai.agent.name,
  attributes.gen_ai.operation.name,attributes.gen_ai.provider.name,
  attributes.gen_ai.request.model,attributes.gen_ai.tool.call.id,
  attributes.gen_ai.tool.name,attributes.gen_ai.tool.type,
  attributes.gen_ai.usage.input_tokens,attributes.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens,case_id,
  resourceAttributes.service.instance.id,resourceAttributes.service.name,
  resourceAttributes.service.version,resourceAttributes.soc.team,
  resourceAttributes.telemetry.sdk.language,resourceAttributes.telemetry.sdk.name,
  resourceAttributes.telemetry.sdk.version,scope.name,scope.version,verdict
Every paged request used limit=5 and followed meta.cursor until the response had
no cursor (meta is {} on the last page). Pages 1-4 hold 5+5+5+1 rows.

  v2_all_fields_page{1..4}.json                200
    GET /api/public/v2/observations?limit=5&fields=FIELDS[&cursor=...]
  v2_all_fields_expand_metadata_page{1..4}.json 200
    GET /api/public/v2/observations?limit=5&fields=FIELDS&expandMetadata=KEYS[&cursor=...]
    Byte-identical to v2_all_fields_*: when the io group is requested, metadata
    comes back untruncated even without expandMetadata.
  v2_no_io_page{1..4}.json                     200
    GET /api/public/v2/observations?limit=5&fields=FIELDS minus io[&cursor=...]
    Shows the 200-character metadata truncation (analyst_note on page 3).
  v2_no_io_expand_metadata_page{1..4}.json     200
    same with &expandMetadata=KEYS; full values.
  legacy_traces_404.json                       404
    GET /api/public/traces?limit=50
  legacy_observations_404.json                 404
    GET /api/public/observations?limit=50
  Not saved (same 404 body): GET /api/public/traces/{traceId},
  GET /api/public/observations/{observationId}, GET /api/public/sessions.
  GET /api/public/integrations/blob-storage -> 403 (needs an organization-scoped key).

Blob storage export (scheduled export to the bundled MinIO)
-----------------------------------------------------------
Available in OSS (entitlement "scheduled-blob-exports" is in the oss plan), but the
public API (PUT /api/public/integrations/blob-storage) needs an organization-scoped
API key, which headless init does not create. Instead the web app's own tRPC routes
were called with a session from the init user (POST /api/auth/callback/credentials):
  POST /api/trpc/blobStorageIntegration.update
    {"json":{"projectId":"proj-local","type":"S3_COMPATIBLE","bucketName":"langfuse",
     "endpoint":"http://minio:9000","region":"auto","accessKeyId":"minio",
     "secretAccessKey":"miniosecret","prefix":"<blob-json2/|blob-jsonl/>",
     "exportFrequency":"hourly","enabled":true,"forcePathStyle":true,
     "fileType":"<JSON|JSONL>","exportMode":"FULL_HISTORY","compressed":false,
     "exportSource":"EVENTS"}}
    (tRPC names the source EVENTS; the public API calls it OBSERVATIONS_V2.
     Default exportFieldGroups: core,basic,time,io,metadata,model,usage,prompt,
     metrics,trace_context,tools.)
  POST /api/trpc/blobStorageIntegration.runNow {"json":{"projectId":"proj-local"}}
  POST /api/trpc/blobStorageIntegration.delete between the JSON and JSONL runs.
Exports are windowed hourly by span start time; all 16 rows landed in the first
window (08:01-09:01Z). Files read back with `mc cat` inside the MinIO container:
  blob_observations_v2.json   <- blob-json2/proj-local/observations_v2/2026-09-30T09-01-00.json
  blob_manifest_json.json     <- blob-json2/proj-local/manifests/2026-09-30T09-01-00.json
  blob_scores.json            <- blob-json2/proj-local/scores/2026-09-30T09-01-00.json ("[]")
  blob_observations_v2.jsonl  <- blob-jsonl/proj-local/observations_v2/2026-09-30T09-01-00.jsonl
  blob_manifest_jsonl.json    <- blob-jsonl/proj-local/manifests/2026-09-30T09-01-00.json
The JSON and JSONL files hold the same 16 rows. Later windows were empty and are
not included.
The UI-triggered batch export was not attempted.

Sanitization
------------
None needed. The saved bodies were searched for the API keys, the host name, the
user name, private IP ranges and e-mail addresses: only user1..4@example.com and
documentation IPs occur. resourceAttributes.service.instance.id is a random UUID
generated by the OpenTelemetry SDK. Files were renamed, never edited.
